Never call "tab new" more than once. Always re-navigate the SAME tab in place (Page.navigate on the same target id). Close that one tab at the very end after capturing final evidence.

Context: A prior upload attempt to YouTube Studio (Vibe Technologies channel, vibeteaichnologies@gmail.com) produced video id jC6yB57t1Oo. YouTube Studio showed "Video published" but the video is actually stuck/broken: oEmbed returns 404, and the Studio edit page for this specific video crashes with "Oops, something went wrong" (confirmed repeatedly, while sibling videos on the same channel render fine).

Task:
1. Open ONE tab, navigate to studio.youtube.com, confirm you're on the Vibe Technologies channel (check account switcher if unsure, do NOT touch any other channel).
2. Go to Content -> Videos list (in the SAME tab, just navigate within it).
3. Find the row for jC6yB57t1Oo (title "OpenCode Mobile — AI coding agent in your pocket #Shorts"). Note its exact visibility/status column value if visible from the LIST view (don't need to open the broken edit page).
4. Delete that stuck video entry (use the list-row "..." menu -> Delete forever, or equivalent). Confirm the deletion dialog.
5. Re-upload the SAME source file: /tmp/ocm_short_final.mp4 (21.3s vertical short, already verified clean footage) via Create -> Upload videos, using the file input[type=file] (not drag-drop).
6. Fill in: Title "OpenCode Mobile — AI coding agent in your pocket #Shorts", Description "Chat with an AI coding assistant from your phone. Connect to your own opencode server, or try the built-in demo. Free & open source. #opencode #AI #coding #mobiledev #Shorts", Visibility: Public.
7. Publish.
8. Get the new video ID / Short URL from the publish confirmation.
9. Take ONE screenshot of the publish confirmation as evidence.
10. Close the tab.

If you hit any blocker (can't find the delete option, deletion fails, wrong channel, 2FA, upload stuck again), STOP immediately and report the exact blocker — do not retry indefinitely and do not open additional tabs to "investigate" further.

Return: old video deleted (yes/no), new video ID/URL, screenshot path, confirmation tab was closed, and total tab count you observed at start vs end (to prove you didn't leave extra tabs).

[2] Good call stopping before the accidental-deletion risk. Skip deletion entirely — it's not required. Leave the old stuck video (jC6yB57t1Oo) alone, don't touch it or any other existing video row.

Use chrome-use, ONE tab only (reuse the same tab you already have open on the safe channel-content list page — don't open a new one). Strict hygiene: close the tab at the end if Chrome allows it; if it refuses (last tab), just leave it on a safe neutral page (e.g. studio.youtube.com dashboard root) and say so.

Task: Upload a NEW video (don't delete/touch anything existing):
1. From wherever you are, click Create -> Upload videos (top right of Studio).
2. Use the input[type=file] element to select /tmp/ocm_short_final.mp4.
3. Title: "OpenCode Mobile — AI coding agent in your pocket #Shorts"
4. Description: "Chat with an AI coding assistant from your phone. Connect to your own opencode server, or try the built-in demo. Free & open source. #opencode #AI #coding #mobiledev #Shorts"
5. Visibility: Public
6. Publish (use defaults for everything else, skip optional steps).
7. Capture the new video's ID/Short URL from the publish confirmation dialog.
8. One screenshot of that confirmation.
9. Return to a safe neutral page (dashboard) or close the tab if possible.

If the upload gets stuck in the wizard, misclicks happen, or anything looks destructive/risky, STOP and report — don't force it.

Return: new video ID/URL, screenshot path, final tab state.
